chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Do not purchase in the Haram except that which has been slaughtered in the Hill, then brought to the Haram already slaughtered; then there is no problem with it for one who is halal (not in ihram)."

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary area in which special legal restrictions apply
key_terms.الْحِلِّ: the area outside the sacred boundary of the Haram
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no legal objection or problem
key_terms.لِلْحَلَالِ: for the person not in a state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy slaughtered meat in the Haram if it was slaughtered outside the sanctuary?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about purchasing slaughtered meat within the Haram. It permits such purchase only when the animal was slaughtered outside the sanctuary, in the Hill, and then brought in already slaughtered, and this applies to a person who is not in a state of ihram.
